import json, subprocess, sys

def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(),
                       capture_output=True, cwd='/app/submission')
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:400])
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

def flag(name): return {"name": name, "type": "FLAG"}
def is_true(f): return {"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":f,"at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}}
def is_false(f): return {"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":f,"at":0},"right":{"const":False,"type":"FLAG"}}
def tr(tid, src, vals, K=1):
    return {"id":tid,"source":src,"rows":[{"t":i,"values":v} for i,v in enumerate(vals)]}
def req(schema, atoms, train, probes, queries, K=1, B=4, S=1, W=1):
    return {"version":1,"window":K,"schema":schema,"atoms":atoms,
            "policy":{"max_width":B,"min_support":S,"min_witness":W},
            "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}

def cls(r):
    return sorted([(c['signature'], c['members'], tuple(sorted((l['atom'],l['negated']) for l in c['representative']['or']))) for c in r['classes']])

fails = []
def expect(name, got, exp):
    if got != exp:
        fails.append((name, got, exp)); print('FAIL', name, '\n  got', got, '\n  exp', exp)
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)

# A: training source with zero contexts kills everything (K=2, short trace)
A = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True]]*3, ), tr("t2","field",[[True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True],[False]])], K=2)
r = run(A)
expect('A zero-context source -> no classes', (cls(r), [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']]),
       ([], [(0,0,'consistent')]))
# note: K=2 and q1 has 2 rows -> 1 context

# A2: same but with the short trace in probes (should not matter)
A2 = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a")],
         [tr("t1","lab",[[True],[True]])],
         [tr("p1","lab",[[False]]), tr("p2","field",[[True]])],
         [tr("q1","lab",[[True],[False]])], K=2)
r = run(A2)
expect('A2 short probe trace ignored', (cls(r), [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']]),
       ([('0',1,(0,False))], [(1,1,'violating')]))

# B: tautology (complementary atoms) must be rejected by condition 5
B = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a"), is_false("a")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True],[False],[True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[True],[False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True],[False]])])
r = run(B)
expect('B tautology rejected', cls(r), [])
expect('B queries consistent', [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']],
       [(0,0,'consistent'),(0,0,'consistent')])

# C: duplicate atom ASTs -> two members in one class
C = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a"), is_true("a")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True],[True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True],[False]])])
r = run(C)
expect('C duplicate atoms', cls(r), [('0',2,(0,False))])
expect('C queries', [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']],
       [(0,0,'consistent'),(1,1,'violating')])

# D: single 2-literal clause, nonzero signature, hex padding
D = req([flag("a"),flag("b")], [is_true("a"), is_true("b")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True,False],[False,True],[True,True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False,False],[True,False],[True,True],[False,True],[False,False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True,False],[False,False],[False,True]])])
r = run(D)
# probes: p0 F,F -> false ; p1 T,F -> true ; p2 T,T -> true ; p3 F,T -> true ; p4 F,F -> false
# signature bits: 0:0,1:1,2:1,3:1,4:0 -> 0b01110 = 14 -> hex 'e' (P=5 -> width 2) -> '0e'
expect('D signature padding', cls(r), [('0e',1,(0,1))])
expect('D queries', [(q['end'],q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']],
       [(0,0,0,'consistent'),(1,1,1,'violating'),(2,0,0,'consistent')])

# E: two classes, no dominance pruning (one class signature superset of another)
E = req([flag("a"),flag("b"),flag("c")], [is_true("a"), is_true("b"), is_true("c")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True,False,False],[False,True,False],[False,False,True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False,False,False],[True,False,False],[False,True,False],[False,False,True]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True,False,False]])])
r = run(E)
# clauses covering all 3 train contexts need all three literals? {a+,b+} covers c0,c1 but not c2 (c=F,T? c2=(F,F,T): a+ F, b+ F) -> no.
# {a+,b+,c+} covers all; witnesses: a+ alone -> c0 (b,c false) ok; b+ -> c1; c+ -> c2. B=4 so allowed.
# probes: p0 all false -> clause false; p1 (T,F,F) -> true; p2 -> true; p3 -> true => sig bits 0,1,1,1 = 0b1110 = 14 -> 'e'
expect('E three literal clause', cls(r), [('e',1,((0,False),(1,False),(2,False)))])

# F: max_width limits clause size (same data as E with B=2 -> nothing)
F = req([flag("a"),flag("b"),flag("c")], [is_true("a"), is_true("b"), is_true("c")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True,False,False],[False,True,False],[False,False,True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False,False,False],[True,False,False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True,False,False]])], B=2)
r = run(F)
expect('F width cap', cls(r), [])

# G: min_support per source, pooled count insufficient
G = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True],[True]]), tr("t2","field",[[False],[True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[False]])], S=2)
r = run(G)
# literal a+ : lab has 2 true, field has 1 true -> fails S=2 -> no clauses
expect('G per-source support', cls(r), [])
G2 = json.loads(json.dumps(G)); G2['policy']['min_support']=1
r = run(G2)
expect('G2 support 1 ok', cls(r), [('0',1,(0,False))])

# H: min_witness per source
H = req([flag("a"),flag("b")], [is_true("a"), is_true("b")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True,False],[True,True]]), tr("t2","field",[[True,True],[True,True]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[False,False]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[False,True]])], W=1)
r = run(H)
# {a+} true everywhere -> singleton eligible (witnesses = its true contexts >= 1 per source)
# {a+,b+}: witnesses for a+ = a true & b false = c0 (lab) 1 ok; field: 0 -> fails W=1 for source field
# {b+}: not true everywhere -> fails
expect('H per-source witness', cls(r), [('0',1,(0,False))])

# I: queries never affect learning
I1 = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a")], [tr("t1","lab",[[True]])], [tr("p1","lab",[[False]])], [])
I2 = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a")], [tr("t1","lab",[[True]])], [tr("p1","lab",[[False]])],
         [tr("q1","lab",[[False],[True],[False]])])
expect('I queries inert', cls(run(I1)), cls(run(I2)))

# J: no probe contexts -> no classes but queries still answered
J = req([flag("a")], [is_true("a")], [tr("t1","lab",[[True]])], [], [tr("q1","lab",[[False]])])
r = run(J)
expect('J no probes', (cls(r), [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']]), ([],[(0,0,'consistent')]))

# K: empty everything
K = req([flag("a")], [], [], [], [])
r = run(K)
expect('K empty', r, {"version":1,"classes":[],"queries":[]})

# L: negated literal clause with signature bits
L = req([flag("a"),flag("b")], [is_true("a"), is_true("b")],
        [tr("t1","lab",[[True,True],[False,False]])],
        [tr("p1","lab",[[True,False],[False,True],[True,True]])],
        [tr("q1","lab",[[True,False],[False,True],[False,False],[True,True]])])
r = run(L)
# literals: 0+ (a), 0- , 1+ (b), 1-
# train c0=(T,T), c1=(F,F). S=1: 0+ true c0 (1) ok; 0- true c1 ok; 1+ ok; 1- ok.
# clauses true on both contexts:
#  {0+,1+}: c1 -> both false -> no
#  {0+,0-}: same atom -> invalid
#  {0+,1-}: c0: a=T -> true. c1: a=F, b=F -> 1- true. covers! witnesses: 0+ & not 1- => 0+ & 1+ = c0 (1) ok; 1- & not 0+ = 1- & 0- = c1 ok -> eligible
#  {0-,1+}: symmetric -> eligible
#  {0+,1+,...} no. Width 3: {0+,1-,x} duplicates atom -> no. So 2 clauses.
# probes p0=(T,F): {0+,1-} true (both) ; {0-,1+}: 0- false,1+ false -> false
#        p1=(F,T): {0+,1-} false ; {0-,1+} true
#        p2=(T,T): both true
# sig for {0+,1-}: bits p0=1,p1=0,p2=1 -> 0b101 = 5 -> '5'
# sig for {0-,1+}: bits 0,1,0 -> 0b010 = 2 -> '2'
expect('L two classes', cls(r), [('2',1,(1,True)),('5',1,(0,True))])
# queries q0=(T,F): class '5' member true -> not false; class '2' member false -> must=1,may=1
# q1=(F,T): class '5' false -> must; class '2' true ->  => must=1,may=1
# q2=(F,F): class '5': 0+ false, 1- true -> true; class '2': 0- true -> true => must 0 may 0
# q3=(T,T): both true => 0,0
expect('L queries', [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']],
       [(1,1,'violating'),(1,1,'violating'),(0,0,'consistent'),(0,0,'consistent')])

print('failures:', len(fails))
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && python3 cornertests.py
